why: Item 1 holds: Check 3 takes function names from Object.keys(require('./math.js')), so a README missing subtract fails. Item 2 breaks in Check 3. Its script requires each function to match the regex '^#+\\s*'+n+'\\s*\\(', a markdown heading like "### name(". PASS also needs "each exported function has a heading with a description in README.md". Line 3 only says README.md "documents every function math.js exports". A README documenting subtract in a list, a table or prose meets the line but fails this check. That is the "specific README layout" requirement the must_not list forbids. Checks 1, 2 and 4 match their lines and are not stricter.
